description: Use when the user names a maker or asks for more about one from search_makers: their public profile by handle (location shown, verification and trust badges, rating, reviews, jobs completed, whether they take design jobs, shop links). An unknown handle returns found: false; use search_makers to find the right one.

handle.description: Maker handle from search_makers, with or without @, e.g. "@handle".
